'''Triloc''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] with a [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] personality who was a member of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Triloc held a mid-level position within the Desilijic clan and in charge of a part of Desilijic's extortion and acquisitions business. She operated primarily from the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and hired various [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], thugs, [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to support her clan's activities.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />

Triloc was ambitious and sought to advance to a more powerful position within Desilijic.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
